reasons: Rule MFN is a direction-type rule whose preferred position is the absence of any MFN obligation on Customer; the absence of MFN language in this transfer and servicing agreement therefore correctly maps to 'compliant' rather than 'missing'.

Cited evidence (fixed Servicing Fee Rate of 0.75%, Article IX 'Other Agreements' and Article X 'Miscellaneous' headers) is consistent with no terms-matching or best-pricing covenant burdening the Issuer/Depositor side, and no Vendor-granted MFN is being disturbed.
Correctly no redline and no counterparty comment for a compliant finding; rendered paragraphs are unchanged and deterministic checks are empty, so there is no over-flagging or spurious edit.
Rationale is accurate and non-actionable by design — retained as internal evidence rather than raised as a negotiation issue.
